items.title: JPMorganChase Commits $750B to US Affordable Housing Push

items.title: JPMorgan Chase Plans Major New Housing Effort
items.summary: $750 billion That's the eye-catching amount that the nation's largest bank said it is investing through 2035 as part of an initiative to support homeownership in the U.S. The initiative has the backing of Chief Executive Jamie Dimon, who has said he is worried about the future of the American economy and wealth inequality.

items.title: JPMorgan Stock Rises as $750 Billion Housing Plan Unfolds
